facts.text: Exposure is the amount of opportunity for an event to happen, measured in units such as operating hours, kilometers driven, loading cycles or close approaches; exposure is the denominator that converts an event count into a rate.
facts.quote: Exposure is the amount of opportunity for something to happen, measured in units such as hours of machine operation, kilometers driven, loading cycles or number of close approaches, and it is the denominator that turns a count of events into a rate.

facts.text: Three unnecessary automatic stops in 600 operating hours correspond to a rate of 0.5 stops per 100 operating hours.
facts.quote: For example, 3 unnecessary automatic stops in 600 operating hours is 0.5 per 100 hours.

facts.text: For operator acceptance, the booklet recommends measuring unnecessary warnings or interventions per operating hour, loading cycle, reverse maneuver and legitimate close approach, broken down by task, rather than false positives per detection.
facts.quote: the useful measures are unnecessary warnings or interventions per operating hour, per loading cycle, per reverse maneuver and per legitimate close approach, broken down by task, rather than false positives per detection [Chapter 4].

facts.text: A system with an excellent overall false-positive rate can still be unusable if nearly every loading cycle contains an unwanted intervention.
facts.quote: A system can have an excellent overall false-positive rate and still be unusable if nearly every loading cycle contains one unwanted intervention [Chapter 4].

facts.text: None of the accident sources examined in the booklet provides operating hours, kilometers or cycles alongside collision counts, preventing calculation of collision rates and like-for-like comparisons between countries or machine types.
facts.quote: None of the accident sources gives operating hours, kilometers or cycles alongside collision counts, so no rate can be computed and no country or machine type compared like for like [Chapter 4].

facts.text: The only field study identified with a clean exposure denominator was small: a haul-truck radar warning system alarmed in 94% of 618 reverse movements over seven days.
facts.quote: The one field study with a clean denominator is small: a radar warning system on a haul truck alarmed in 94% of 618 reverse movements over seven days [Chapter 4].

facts.text: A RAND study found that demonstrating self-driving-car safety through driving alone would require hundreds of millions, and sometimes hundreds of billions, of miles.
facts.quote: A RAND study found that showing the safety of self-driving cars by driving alone would take hundreds of millions, sometimes hundreds of billions, of miles

facts.text: Off-road machines accumulate far less exposure per unit than cars, making the driving-only safety-demonstration problem worse on a job site.
facts.quote: off-road machines accumulate far less exposure per unit than cars, so the problem is worse on a job site [Chapter 1].

facts.text: Statistical shortcuts that concentrate testing on rare dangerous situations require a known exposure distribution, but such a distribution does not exist for 100 or more site types.
facts.quote: Statistical shortcuts that concentrate tests on rare dangerous situations need a known exposure distribution, which does not exist for 100 or more site types [Chapter 1].

facts.text: The booklet recommends building an exposure model early in the collision-mitigation program by recording how often each task, approach and environment occurs in the existing warning fleet.
facts.quote: An exposure model is therefore one of the first things the booklet asks the program to build, by recording from the existing warning fleet how often each task, approach and environment actually occurs [Chapters 1, 9].

facts.text: Without exposure data, the collision-mitigation program cannot estimate how often the new system will brake unnecessarily, weight test results to real-world operation or claim an event rate.
facts.quote: Without exposure the program cannot say how often the new system will brake unnecessarily, cannot weight test results to the real world, and cannot claim a rate of anything.
